cards.title: Cylinder finite-strip Hamiltonian for T001

source_refs.value: Suppose that the cylinder has periodic-boundary condition in the x direction and open boundaries in the y direction.

cards.latex: H_y(k_x)=\sum_y c_y^\dagger M(k_x)c_y+\sum_y c_y^\dagger T_y c_{y+1}+\sum_y c_{y+1}^\dagger T_y^\dagger c_y
cards.role: Turns the Bloch Hamiltonian into the finite strip eigenproblem for Fig. 3(b): periodic x, open y.

checks.reason: Cylinder paragraph states periodic x, open y, and diagonalization as a family of 1D Hamiltonians parametrized by k_x.
Open-boundary section gives T_y=-t_y/2 sigma_z-i v_y/2 sigma_y and its reverse hopping T_y^dagger.
The finite-strip spectrum has the paper-scale row count and a resolution-stable chiral trace separated from the bulk line gap.

cards.numerical_form: M(k_x)=(v_x sin k_x+i gamma_x) sigma_x+i gamma_y sigma_y+(m-t_x cos k_x+i gamma_z) sigma_z; T_y=-t_y/2 sigma_z-i v_y/2 sigma_y; reverse hopping is T_y^dagger.
open_questions: Boundary-localization candidates are retained as diagnostics; the rendered red subset now follows the analytic chiral edge trace E_+=sin(kx)+i gamma and E_-=-sin(kx)-i gamma.
